extensions.name: Temporary NPCs
extensions.summary: Ephemeral filler NPCs with 3-turn decay, same-name refresh, despawn on move-on, and Promote to Named Cast.
extensions.description: Adds lightweight temporary background NPCs that decay after 3 turns, refresh when the same name reappears, despawn when the scene moves on, and can be promoted into the named cast.

extensions.name: Dynamic Memory
extensions.summary: Preview companion for dynamic lorebook entries and fading memory in LPE.
extensions.description: Lightweight preview/upcoming sub-extension for dynamic lorebook updates and fading-memory behavior. Treat availability and feature scope as preview until the companion repository documents a stable release.
